summary: Sprint 4 (Region Intelligence + Category Verification) fully validated end-to-end. All 15 backend Sprint 4 tests pass (9 test_studio_sprint4.py + 6 test_sprint4_generalization.py). critical_code_review_comments: React hydration warning in browser console: <span> cannot be a child of <option> in ReviewTab select at MaterialMatchStudio.jsx line 536 — cosmetic React DOM warning caused by dev-wrapper x-instrumentation on option children, not a functional bug. Safe to ignore, but flagging for cleanliness.
